name: History and Cultural Anthropology, BA (Boston)
disclaimer: NU Map is an independent, student-built planner. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data is scraped from Northeastern's public catalog and refreshed on a schedule; always confirm with the official catalog and an academic advisor.

legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. A section can consist of nothing but these. Quote them; never infer from them that a particular course does or does not satisfy the section.
legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.

requirementSections.title: Pre-1800 History Elective
notes: Complete one course from the following:

requirementSections.title: History Elective
notes: Complete two HIST courses at any level in any field.

requirementSections.title: Introductory Level Elective
notes: Complete one history course from the 1000 level.

requirementSections.title: Intermediate/Advanced History Elective
notes: Complete minimum of one HIST course numbered 2000 to 2999 (excluding HIST 2301 and HIST 2302).

requirementSections.title: Advanced History Elective
notes: Complete minimum of one HIST course numbered 3000 to 4999 (excluding HIST 4701).

requirementSections.title: Area Courses
notes: Complete two area courses in the range ANTH 4101-ANTH 4520 not used to fulfill other requirements. One study abroad course may be substituted for an area studies course with prior permission from the department.

requirementSections.title: Anthropology Electives
notes: Complete three courses in the following range not used to satisfy other requirements (ANTH 2000-ANTH 4999). One study-abroad course may count toward this requirement.

requirementSections.title: Integrative Requirements
notes: Anthropology area studies courses: choose any area studies course between ANTH 4101-ANTH 4520 not used to fulfill other requirements.
